description: Lint pasted email HTML. Checks: size against the roughly 102 KB point where Gmail clips a message, doctype, charset, viewport and lang, layout built on divs, flexbox, grid, float or positioning instead of tables (Outlook for Windows renders with the Word engine and ignores much modern CSS), background shorthand and background images (need VML and a colour fallback for Outlook), CSS variables, calc, rem/vw units, web fonts without fallback, <style> reliance without inline styles, container width (about 600 to 640 px is the convention), images without alt, width or display:block, image-only mail that goes blank when images are blocked, hidden preheader, color-scheme meta, small tap targets on button-like links, missing or odd unsubscribe link, JavaScript and forms, empty or http links. Email client support notes are from our own testing notes dated 2026-10 and may have drifted. Confirm in real clients (Litmus, Email on Acid, or seed accounts) before sending.
name: lint_email_html
title: Email HTML lint
